passages.context: Book III.VI, printed pp. 227–228, 'Item alia missa': Collect 'Deus, qui omnipotentiam tuam parcendo maxime et miserando manifestas: multiplica super nos gratiam tuam ...'; Secret 'Tibi, Domine, sacrificia dicata reddantur ... ut eadem remedia fieri nostra praestares'; and Postcommunion 'Quaesumus, Domine Deus noster, ut quos divinis reparare non desinis sacramentis, tuis non destituas benignus auxiliis'.
passages.notes: The exact page images were inspected. Wilson's normalized printing establishes the set and the Collect's 'gratiam' variant relative to the 1962 Roman Missal's 'misericordiam'; it does not establish authorship or original calendar assignment.
